15 Free Online Tools Every Student Needs in 2026

By the DoraPDF team · 2 min read · Updated 2026-11-06

Assignments, notes, applications and presentations — student life runs on files. These free tools work right in your browser with no sign-up.

For assignments

  1. Scan to PDF — turn handwritten pages into a clean PDF with your phone.
  2. PDF Merger — combine all your pages and documents into one file for submission.
  3. Word to PDF — submit work in a format that looks the same on your teacher's screen.
  4. PDF to Word — edit a PDF handout or past paper.
  5. Word Counter — hit the word limit exactly.

For uploads and applications

  1. PDF Compressor — get under 1 MB or 2 MB upload limits.
  2. Image Resizer — resize photos to the exact pixels a form asks for.
  3. HEIC to JPG — fix iPhone photos that won't upload.
  4. Images to PDF — turn certificate photos into one document.

For studying

  1. GPA Calculator — know where you stand before results.
  2. Percentage Calculator — marks, discounts and increases in seconds.
  3. Pomodoro Timer — focus in 25-minute sprints.
  4. PDF to Markdown — paste clean notes into AI tools.

For presentations

  1. PDF to PowerPoint — turn a PDF into slides.
  2. QR Code Generator — put a link to your project on the last slide.

All of these run on your own device, so your files stay private. Bookmark dorapdf.com and you'll always have them ready.
